limits: This is an opt-in development example, not production hardening or a real credential receiver.
Plaintext synthetic loopback does not establish native TLS roots/handshake, real service auth, ASR quality or durable provisioning.
Self-checks and proc ownership/access denials do not observe actual core suppression or pipe-helper non-dispatch; historical G1 remains unmet and Linux live NO_GO.
Root/CAP_SYS_PTRACE, WSL root from the same Windows user, relays/kernel pipe buffers, swap/VM/WER, races and fatal termination remain outside this protection.
Guest pidfd/subreaper cleanup is separate from the Windows bridge job; external supervisor termination/power loss can interrupt it.
The held-EOF observation plus source contract excludes SDK entry before EOF; it is not an acknowledgement of each byte read.
Counts are per command/case, not added as new distinct SDK tests or real service sessions.
No retry, audio replay, private capture or service-budget reset.
